title: Make a deck, memo or web page from your notes with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini | mindseeder
description: Turn a mindseeder harvest document (Markdown) into a PowerPoint deck, a PDF or Word decision memo, a report or a single HTML page with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Free paths, steps and copy-ready requests.
h1: Make a deck, memo or web page from your notes with your AI
lead: mindseeder exports the conclusion you chose as Markdown. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini with one of the requests below and get a finished file: a PDF or Word memo, a PowerPoint deck, a report or one HTML page.
checked: Service features checked on 18 November 2026. Plans and features change; check your own account.
s1: In harvest mode (H on a keyboard, the menu on a phone), put the conclusions you chose in the basket and press Export document (MD). Open the file and copy all of it.
s2_h: Pick a service for the format you need
s2: Both Gemini and Claude can make every format below on a free account. ChatGPT makes PDF and Word for free in canvas; its Slides need Pro or above. Perplexity's file creation is paid only.
s3_h: Paste a request, then the Markdown
s3: Copy a request, paste it into a new chat, then paste your Markdown under it. Each request keeps numbers, quotes, minus signs and links exactly as written and adds nothing that is not in your notes.
prompts: Conclusion first, then evidence, risks, next steps and sources. PDF, and Word if the service can.
One message a slide, original sentences in the speaker notes. PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Conclusion box, evidence, sources; no external scripts. Download the .html file.
Report with a table of contents
Contents, page numbers, sections and an appendix of the original notes. PDF.
s4_h: Check the file before you send it
tips: Open the file and compare every number, quote and link with your notes. The requests ask the AI to report this, but read it yourself.
Korean text in a generated PDF can show as boxes when the service has no Korean font. Ask it to use Noto Sans KR or Nanum Gothic, or export to Google Docs first and download the PDF from there.
A PowerPoint file does not carry its fonts. In desktop PowerPoint turn on File, Options, Save, Embed fonts in the file before you share it.
Content marked as a fictional example stays marked; keep it that way in anything you send.
